req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. The violation was in test[5]: kind='negative' but heuristic='EP'. The rule requires that a negative kind test must not use EP (EP is reserved for positive equivalence partitions in this context). Fix: change heuristic from 'EP' to 'NEG' for that test, which is semantically correct since it is testing an error/negative equivalence class with explicit status-code mutation resilience. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the pre-loaded dataset
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 10
trace: R-PLAYER-037: valid integer segment must NOT trigger 422; confirms the positive partition works and the 422 guard is not over-broad
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_by_squad_number_status_code_is_exactly_422_not_400_or_404():

    assert r.status_code == 422

    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
